note: Alberta Parks campground along Long Lake: six campgrounds (A-F) off one park road in aspen, pine and spruce forest, with long sandy beaches, playgrounds, a boat launch, and a concession with groceries in the day use area; the White Earth Valley Trail runs from the south end. Campground B's unserviced sites are listed at 20-21 ft, so a 23-ft rig is limited to the power sites and four unserviced sites in Campground C. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: unserviced $31 and 15/30-amp power $39, season May 14 - Oct 13 (2026), reservable 90 days ahead (the note's 180 days was wrong). Sites set to the page's 214 (69 unserviced + 145 power), max 41 ft; hookups and facilities (showers, flush and vault toilets, tap water, dump, laundry, store) written. Note rewritten. Waterfront downgrade recommended; phone and website flagged.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront - recommend lakeview): the page says 'Long Lake Campground is located along the shores of Long Lake' and the shop tags 37 sites 'Near Water' (A-05, A-07, A-08, A-10, A-11; C-125, C-127, C-129, C-132; D-146, D-147; E-168-171, E-173, E-174, E-176-179, E-181; F-206, F-209, F-211, F-213, F-215). On Esri imagery the shore is wooded almost everywhere: Campground A's east pads (about 54.4344,-112.7625) sit 40-70 m from the water with a band of trees/shrub on most of the bank and a shoreline path, the only open ground being a grassy patch at the loop's south-east corner that reaches the path about 35-45 m from the nearest pad; the strip of sites along the shore road to the south has a continuous belt of trees 20-40 m deep between road/pads and water; the southern loop by the boat launch has a road and path between it and the shore. No pad is clearly within ~50 m with only open ground between, so after every source it goes down. A view over the open patch from A's east row (A-05 to A-11) and from the tagged sites is plausible, so lakeview.

SHORT SITES (criteria note, not a drop): every Campground B unserviced site (53, B-064 to B-123) is listed at 20-21 ft, and C-124-126, C-128-132, A-04, A-14, A-27, D-138, D-139, D-141, D-156, D-157 at 21 ft. A 23-ft rig still fits the other power sites (31-41 ft) and unserviced C-133 to C-136 (31 ft), so the $31 base stands.

SITE COUNT (stored 226 from note prose): page 69 unserviced + 145 power (+6 walk-in tent); the shop lists 62 unserviced, 145 power and 13 'Tent Only' (6 in A, 7 in B) - the page's 69 likely counts B's tent-only sites. 214 written from the page.
